security_justification.trust_boundary: The new check reads the same contributor subjects already consumed by the CLI; it introduces no principal, network endpoint or trust crossing and leaves GitHub fetching unchanged.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No owner decision, signed record, pin or authoritative audit context changes; assessment and passing gates are technical evidence only, never inferred approval.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: GitHub token handling and permissions remain unchanged; rejecting a descriptive label does not grant or revoke application access or change authentication.
security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, canonical contract or log integrity mechanism changes; the gate corrects release-description quality rather than security audit data semantics.
security_justification.confidentiality: The check consumes only the same titles and commit subjects as before; no credentials or confidential payloads are newly collected, stored or transmitted.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Implementation is limited to the existing subject check, its CLI tests and task ticks; the mutant is owned by an external disposable directory and never rewrites live source.
security_justification.fail_posture: The descriptive gate becomes stricter with explicit exit 1 for leading labels; existing conventional-format rejections remain, with no application security fail-open or fallback change.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Failures include the already checked subject and a fixed explanatory phrase, not tokens, request headers or new caller data; existing context remains visible.
security_justification.concurrency: The correction adds a local synchronous predicate and child-process CLI assertions, not shared runtime state, locks, scheduling or concurrent coordination.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK, release or governance lifecycle transition changes; proposal and implementation retain their existing separate-commit ordering and archive remains a separate PR.
security_justification.resource_retention: Only the planted control adds a disposable external mutant file, removed in finally; no production retention policy, persistent store or cleanup ownership changes.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: GitHub pagination remains intact, with no added retries or redelivery behavior; the subject predicate makes one deterministic decision per input.
security_justification.cryptography: No keys, algorithms, signatures, hashes or cryptographic verification changes; SHA-256 in a positive fixture is ordinary descriptive text, not a cryptographic operation.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Fixtures use synthetic subject strings and add no personal data, telemetry, redaction rule or privacy transformation; production input handling remains unchanged.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security service or integration is added; existing GitHub commit fetching is preserved and CLI title tests run without network access.
